question: Estimate the market size of online gaming (excluding fantasy sports) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Real-money gaming (rummy, poker) included? Include rummy/poker (legal in most states pre-2023 ban) but flag uncertainty post-GST/regulation.
Casual mobile gaming (in-app purchases + ads) included? Yes.
Esports/console gaming included? Esports yes; console + PC small.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up by sub-segment: casual mobile + RMG (rummy/poker) + esports + console/PC.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Casual mobile gaming: 500M players (Free Fire, BGMI, Ludo King); paying ~5% = 25M; ARPU ~₹400/yr; revenue: ₹10,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: RMG (rummy/poker, post-GST ban on online RMG with stakes lower-than-prize): heavily contracted; ~₹4,000-5,000 Cr (down from ₹15,000 Cr peak).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Console + PC (Steam, PS5 sales digital): ~₹1,500 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 500M players (Free Fire, BGMI, Ludo King); paying ~5% = 25M; ARPU ~₹400/yr; revenue: ₹10,000 Cr.

calculationFlow: Casual mobile gaming: 500M players (Free Fire, BGMI, Ludo King); paying ~5% = 25M; ARPU ~₹400/yr; revenue: ₹10,000 Cr.
RMG (rummy/poker, post-GST ban on online RMG with stakes lower-than-prize): heavily contracted; ~₹4,000-5,000 Cr (down from ₹15,000 Cr peak).
Console + PC (Steam, PS5 sales digital): ~₹1,500 Cr.
